title: Megurine Luka — Lay Your Feelings Bare〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Phew...
How was that?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That was awesome...!
You two were so smooth.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I thought your part at the end was very cool, An!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, I thought the same thing!
But I'm not about to let you hog all the glory...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Likewise!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You and An seem to be doing much better together now, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Much better?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm not sure how to describe it, but you two sound so optimistic about each other and the future now...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you for saying that...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wait, whoa!
We gotta get back! It's almost time for us to meet!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right!
Uhh... Then, if you'll all excuse us!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Okay, have fun!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I wasn't able to express what I felt in the end.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I think I understand what you were trying to say, Luka.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I could also tell that they've become better partners as a result of them battling against each other and actually saying what they were feeling.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, me as well!
They've really taken a big step forward!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Still, I honestly couldn't tell that An was that afraid about Kohane leaving her behind.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Me neither...
But you knew for a while, right, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I apologize for hiding it from all of you, but I really didn't feel comfortable telling.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's understandable. It's a delicate topic, and it's clear you were just trying to help An.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But you also knew, didn't you, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes, but...
Through eavesdropping...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She really just found out by accident.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Still, I'm really glad you did.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Because if you hadn't suggested that she tell Kohane everything, I don't think she would've got to this point.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Thank you, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But to be perfectly honest, I was really nervous after I gave An that advice.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. In that moment, it seemed like the right thing to say... But there was also a chance that it could cause irreparable harm.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I mean, what if An doing what I said caused her and Kohane to stop being friends?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, in the event that happened...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: My plan was to ask all of you to help get them to make up and start over!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I doubt I'd be able to come up with a way to fix things by myself. That being said, making Miku find a solution also didn't feel right...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Which is why I was going to ask all of you for your help.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: At the same time, I didn't want to get you all wrapped up in the situation once it had already become a mess.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wait, why not?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: In a situation like that, we'd be more than happy to help you, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I'd help too!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Same here!
Why wouldn't we want to help you?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I agree. If you find yourself in trouble, then you shouldn't hesitate to ask for our help! We'll do whatever we can!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: All of you...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, Luka...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Moving forward, please feel free to ask us for help when you're in a bind.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Did you hear that, Luka?
By the way, I agree with her completely.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
...!
Thank you all so much!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hearing you all say that makes me so happy...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And I'd like to ask for a favor right away!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I just spilled some of the sauce on my sandwich and...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The sauce on your sandwich...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
What should I do?!
I had so much on there, but my sandwich is going to lose all its flavor now...!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, I know!
MEIKO, can I get some more of that sauce...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: No, you're going to clean up the mess you made first!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What?! Why are you mad all of a sudden?!
